results.title: Prince William's Polo Dilemma: Tradition vs. Modern Royal Expectations
results.description: The heir to the throne's annual polo match sparks debate over royal tradition and contemporary priorities. A senior polo figure critiques perceived elitism, while palace courtiers urge William to focus on environmental and social causes. The story examines the tension between heritage and progress within the monarchy, and the future of royal engagement with sports.

results.title: US Sanctions Against ICC Draw UN Chief Guterres' Criticism As Eight Nations Defend Court's Independence & International Justice
results.description: UN chief Antonio Guterres and foreign ministers of eight nations criticised US sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC), warning they could undermine international justice. The countries reaffirmed their support for the court's independence and accountability for serious crimes.
